text_block_list.text: One day, with the Spring Tenno Sho fast approaching—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah... Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What's wrong?
Don't you look a bit haggard?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, well... haha. You're quite sharp.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing serious, just a slight lack of sleep.
...Which is precisely why I came to this nap spot you recommended.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Do you have any recent
materials on Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...If anything were to shake her,
it'd probably be something regarding her little sister.
choice_data_list: By "that guy," do you mean Hayahide?
By "that guy," do you mean Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...So, about Brian.
Has there been any big news lately?"

Following their advice, I looked into it and found
news coverage of the recent Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"1st place in the 'Satsuki Sho'... Hmph,
and she set a new course record, too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Still a true "monster," as always...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Did Hayahide know about this and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um... hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"When people talk... what are you
normally supposed to do?"
choice_data_list: (Taishin is being caring toward her friends...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
You aren't thinking of doing something unnecessary, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Never mind that! Hurry up and answer me!!"
choice_data_list: You should go grab a meal together or something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Food?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcooome!!
Please take any seat you like!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, 'sup...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...Taishin, you're... well, you're not particularly a regular customer here, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As if.
I barely ever eat out...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right. That's just the kind of girl you are.
If so, however... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Why did you invite me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That's...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Umamusume ladies! What can I get for ya?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, um—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Vegetable ramen, extra carrots...
Ah, one with less noodles, please...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, I saw a video of the Nikkei Sho.
That was a magnificent run, Taishin."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yeah... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you close in with that final spurt still sends chills down my spine.
...I can't even count how many times your late-race kick made me rewrite my formulas.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Does that mean you thought they were strong?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well... to put it bluntly, yes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always thought Hayahide
was a real pain in the neck."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I've always thought so. ...Even now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You—don't tell me, you're trying to cheer me up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "W-Wait... it's not like that!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's just, like…… for someone who's such a pain,
you've got no right going and losing confidence on your own, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Even the small portion was too much...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely not fine... *sigh*.
I am never going back to that shop ever again..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Is that so? That's too bad.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I certainly hoped to come here with you again, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey, Taishin—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Will you believe in this
'troublesomeness' of mine?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Believe?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I... believe you.
After all, you really are a pain to deal with.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haha.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ("Trust"... huh.)

Blown by the spring night breeze,
Narita Taishin let out a faint smile.
